en: Black‑and‑white postcard-style image of a large, ornate, three‑story brick commercial building occupying a street corner. The structure has arched windows, decorative stonework, and a prominent central corner tower with a domed roof. Ground-floor storefronts wrap around both visible facades; one corner entrance is marked as a bank, and there are painted signs for various businesses. Horse-drawn carriages and a few pedestrians stand along the unpaved street, with utility poles and overhead wires visible, suggesting an early 20th‑century urban setting.
